# Barrowby Brickworks - kiln gas log

One row per kiln run. A run is charged the gas metered to its kiln between the
start and end dates on the row. Two runs were worked in September, each one
split over two firings on the kilns numbered 1 and 2.

turns.prompt: Barrowby Brickworks is filling in the September energy return. What did the September run cost us in gas?
The Sept-B run. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
